Delighting both the spectators and her 
fellow runners with an incredible 
performance, Maruzensky swept through the 
Tenno Sho (Autumn) and seized victory.

Looking back on the race, Special Week 
reflected on how much fun it was to have 
competed.

Maruzensky's heart leaped with excitement 
as she resolved to keep on running, 
looking forward to enjoying races against 
such passionate contenders in the future.
